setupQuestions: Does the skill resume repository state without unnecessary clarification?
Does it convert literature/referee findings into theorem-level actions?
Does it distinguish Observed, Verified, Proved, and Published/Established correctly?
Does it avoid launching a full research campaign for routine textbook questions?
Does it leave durable research state on disk when a campaign task is requested?

scenarios.title: Paper or Remark mining
scenarios.purpose: Test Seed-0 routing, literature positioning, proof obligations and concrete repository progress.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local skill math-research-full-push. Treat an existing paper/remark research target in this workspace as Seed 0, recover the current state, identify the most important unresolved mathematical obligation, and make a concrete research update on disk. Do not merely describe a plan.
successChecklist: Uses the paper/remark as Seed 0 rather than broad topic search.
Produces a concrete research delta on disk.
Separates literature evidence from proof evidence.

scenarios.title: Autonomous continuation
scenarios.purpose: Check that a short continuation command resumes the real frontier instead of asking what to continue.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local skill math-research-full-push. 继续推进当前数学研究。读取仓库状态，选择最高优先级未解决问题并实际推进，保存结果。
successChecklist: Does not ask what to continue when repository state is sufficient.

scenarios.title: Theorem strengthening
scenarios.purpose: Test falsification-first strengthening plus targeted prior-art recheck.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local skill math-research-full-push. 继续增强当前最强定理：先快速反证更强版本，再尝试去假设、分类等号或得到 iff/更一般结构；对真正升级后的命题重新检查 prior art，并把结论写入仓库。
successChecklist: Falsifies stronger variants before committing to them.
Rechecks prior art after material strengthening.

scenarios.title: JCTA-style escalation
scenarios.purpose: Test whether referee pressure creates mathematical upgrades rather than defensive prose.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local skill math-research-full-push. 按 JCTA/高水平期刊标准推进当前论文：做一次严厉模拟审稿，把最严重的数学问题转成明确 proof/literature/verification obligations，并至少关闭其中一个高优先级问题。
successChecklist: Turns objections into explicit mathematical obligations.
Closes or materially advances at least one obligation.

scenarios.title: Literature and background
scenarios.purpose: Test targeted seed/citation/prior-art workflow rather than bibliography accumulation.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local skill math-research-full-push. 补充当前研究的参考文献和背景：从当前定理/Seed 0 出发，补齐最危险 prior art、open-status 和背景研究链，并让文献结果影响下一步定理或证明策略。
successChecklist: Uses targeted seed and theorem-to-theorem comparison.
Avoids claiming open status from an old source alone.
Connects literature findings to theorem/proof strategy.

scenarios.title: Routine-math boundary
scenarios.purpose: Check that the skill does not overreach on a routine textbook exercise.
scenarios.userInput: This is only a boundary test for math-research-full-push: solve the elementary exercise 'prove that the sum of two even integers is even'. Do not create a research campaign, literature audit, branch, or publication workflow unless genuinely necessary.
successChecklist: Does not launch the long-horizon research workflow.
Keeps the response proportional to the elementary task.
Does not create unnecessary repository artifacts.
